method: Pairs written by debar_measure.py. idb-ceis: every normalised-name match between an IDB-listed firm located in Brazil and a CEIS legal person (4 pairs, no sampling), checked by reading both records (legal name, registry name, CNPJ, sanctioning body and state, dates, grounds, co-sanctioned firms). idb-adb: random sample (seed 20261118) of 20 of the name-matched firms whose names carry a legal-form word, checked on name, nationality, sanction dates and the declared cross-debarment origin in both lists. A pair counts as correct only when attributes beyond the name support it. Firms and organisations only: rows flagged Individual (IDB Entity, ADB entityType) and CEIS natural persons (TIPO DE PESSOA = F or blank) were dropped before matching, and names without a legal-form word are never written. ADB is a parked source (terms); its pairs are evidence of the cross-debarment overlap, not a dataset join.
